d: No phones, stricter team rules, a wider selection policy and plenty of Klopp humour. Jurgen Klopp is bringing more than his famous high-intensity football philosophy to the Germany national team. Following the emphatic 5-0 win over the Netherlands, questions are being asked about whether the former Liverpool manager can restore German football's identity and confidence. Rupha Ramani looks at Klopp's leadership style, dressing-room culture and the personality behind Germany's new energy.
